Client-supplied accounting fields are discarded. Numeric timestamps, durations and token counts must be nonnegative JavaScript-safe integers; token counts may be null. Settings and attachment shapes are validated. This endpoint does not establish authoritative request charges or detect secrets embedded in conversation text. Omit expectedRevision for a compatibility write only while the owned record has not enabled guarded writes. Explicit null creates only if no owned row exists; a canonical positive decimal revision updates only that exact owned version. Stale, missing or duplicate-create guarded writes return 409 without replacing content. Revisions are global sequence values, not timestamps, and are never reused by API delete/recreate. Guarded success includes a decimal revision; direct GET provides it. A successful guarded creation/update permanently enables guarded writes on that owned row. Compatibility saves thereafter return 409; there is no content-write downgrade. A content-free guard identity survives deletion, so legacy autosaves cannot resurrect a protected reference; explicit null guarded creation may recreate it. Untouched legacy rows retain compatibility behavior until guarded save.

post.x-niu-status: Basic chat is implemented for configured native provider routes. Local buffered_full output rules support single-choice plain text streaming: retain the real upstream stream until terminal evidence, inspect the complete bounded output, then emit compatible sanitized chunks. Required output withholding emits a guardrail_output_withheld SSE error without [DONE]; known executed usage remains billable. Text buffering is limited to 1 MiB and total stream bytes to 2 MiB, with four concurrent collectors per process. Output rules with tools or structured format remain unsupported. Observation-only plain-text streams preserve delivery and asynchronously record clear, matched or indeterminate without transforming output. Mandatory and observation rules compose across workspace/key scopes. Optional collection and inspection have separate bounded capacity; observation overload does not deny the request. Function tools, streaming tool deltas, and structured JSON are opt-in on OpenAI-compatible routes only. Partial deltas are provisional; invalid final output sends an upstream_invalid_response SSE error without [DONE], while reported terminal usage remains accounting evidence. Token-priced routes support function calls and text-only tool-result conversations under the same input/output rates. Serialized messages, tool definitions, tool choices and response-format instructions count toward the configured input byte guard. Hosted tools and additional billable modalities remain unsupported. Chat pools allow at most one different-credential successor after a canonical OpenRouter immediate HTTP 401 with durable nonexecution and released holds, preserving operation price and funding under one deadline. revision.description: Trimmed canonical revision with no control characters; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

model_alias.description: Must match the enclosing model alias.

upstream_model.description: Must match the enclosing upstream mapping.

channel.description: Exact canonical channel contract; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

required_controls.description: Every named control must be configured.

exclusive_controls.description: Each pair names distinct configured controls; both cannot have defaults.

callbacks_qualified.description: Required for a callback_url declaration; separate adapter/offer qualification and callback authentication still apply.

VideoInputRule.description: Item/count bounds cannot exceed the enclosing request limits. Non-text inputs require HTTPS or at least one allowed Base64 MIME type; required roles need at least one allowed role. Names are trimmed, control-free and limited to 256 UTF-8 bytes.

VideoIntegerControl.description: Signed 64-bit integer bounds; maximum must be at least minimum and any default must lie within them. The dashboard edits exact JavaScript-safe integers only.

VideoChoiceControl.description: Values are canonical names of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; any default must be one of them.

VideoOutputSchema.description: Optional effective output mapping for this schema revision. Requires resolution, ratio and positive duration controls, each with a default or required input. Pixel estimation additionally requires a positive frames_per_second control; seconds estimation may omit it. Missing resolution/ratio combinations reject requests before dispatch. Estimates never establish reported usage or maximum liability. The ark-direct-v1 adapter qualifies video_tokens only; openrouter-video-v1 supports owner-funded text generation with seconds estimates and unknown reported quantity.

estimator_revision.description: Reviewed configuration reference; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

resolution.description: Must be accepted by the configured resolution control.

ratio.description: Must be accepted by the configured ratio control; each resolution/ratio pair is unique.

pricing.description: Optional validated route pricing. Personal-owned credentials require null pricing; non-null pricing is rejected at save. Null clears pricing; omission preserves existing pricing on updates and leaves cost unknown on creates.

estimate.description: Saved estimated quantity priced using the original customer tariff. Neither confirmed usage, maximum liability nor a final charge. Owner-funded or unpriceable amounts remain null.
